items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: That's the first time I heard of it... We worked in the Cotton Club as a substitute for Cab Calloway's band.

ctx.x: No. No, I wasn't in the theatre then. That's the first time I heard of it. They were so successful, Mills booked them right into the Cotton Club, and he sent Cab Calloway on the road.
And that's when you joined again.
